class: A write guard that protects a verifier's independence by moving any new file under work/, spec/ or evidence/ while a verifier runs cannot tell the orchestrator's writes from the verifier's, and it watches every worktree of the repo, not only the verifier's own folder - so the orchestrator's cards and spec edits made in parallel, even in a separate worktree, silently disappear into quarantine.
mechanism: The verifier's PostToolUse write-guard diffs work/, spec/ and evidence/ across the repo's worktrees after each verifier tool call and moves new untracked files to %TEMP%/verifier-quarantine/<stamp>/ (MANIFEST action 'moved'); tracked edits are 'copied'. The workaround written on 2026-10-16 morning (use a scratch worktree) assumed it watched only the main checkout.

first_seen.evidence: work/W-083.md written mid-verification vanished; restored from the quarantine MANIFEST

fix: Structural: the guard watches only the verifier's own verify folder (the path it created), never other worktrees - a kit change (harvest issue). Filed as abhayla/Startup-Factory issue 110 (harvest, 2026-10-16). Until then: no card/spec/evidence write anywhere while a verifier is in flight; draft outside any git worktree and copy in after it returns; on a vanished file, restore from the newest MANIFEST and compare sha256.

detection.note: Detected only by noticing a missing file. The orchestrator compares git status of its own worktrees before and after each verifier (deliver step 4) - that check found this one.
